title: Transport of section-source exchange to the pro-etale site
statement: For every finite commutative coefficient ring A, a Cartesian square for h and compatible closed sections s and s′, assume the etale section-source exchange equation. Then the transported pro-etale source satisfies the corresponding equation for the actual pro-etale compactification exchange, with proBeta and the scalar-preserving constant pullback. Use the exact maps of [def-pur-section-compact-source-maps]. No Noetherian or finite-type condition is imposed on the new base.

proof.text: Expand proSource as the inverse compareConstant followed by the comparison of etaleSource and sourceComparison. The supported endpoint transport square identifies sourceComparison followed by the actual pro-etale exchange with the compared etale exchange. The scalar-unit square identifies the initial endpoint. Naturality of the pullback comparison moves etaleSource through this identification. Apply the supplied etale equation, use functoriality, and cancel the inverse comparison factors. This is implemented by the proved categorical helper transport_section. No section equation or coefficient hypothesis changes.

proof_origin.place: Step 3, explicit categorical transport with separate supported and scalar endpoint squares; group J6

theorem pro_section_exchange_component [Finite A]
    {B X B' X' : Scheme.{u}} {h : X ⟶ B} {h' : X' ⟶ B'}
    {v : X' ⟶ X} {g : B' ⟶ B} (sq : IsPullback v h' h g)
    (c : Compactification h) (s : B ⟶ X) (s' : B' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s']
    (hs : s ≫ h = 𝟙 B) (hs' : s' ≫ h' = 𝟙 B')
    (sqS : ChosenCartesianSquare g s' s v)
    (he : (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (etaleSource A c s hs).hom ≫
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlusBaseChangeMap A sq c).app
        (etaleSupported A s) ≫
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map (etaleBeta A sqS) =
      (constantPull A g).hom ≫ (etaleSource A (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' hs').hom) :
    (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        (proSource A c s hs) ≫
      proExchange A sq c (proSupported A s) ≫
      (ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationPlus
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (c.ofIsPullback sq)).map (proBeta A sqS) =
      (proConstantPull A g).hom ≫ proSource A (c.ofIsPullback sq) s' hs'
